items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: That was on a fella named Twenna... I just remember his first name. Now this is the band caused me to have a tuba.

ctx.x: Oh, the Pelican. Pelican dance hall, yes. You remember when the Pelican was. Yes.
That is not my instrument, but I had one. Well, you've got to ask too. That was on a fella named Twenna.
